$Comment: MMO Mob Scaling BOSS tagset (native NPCGroup). Two independent things key off membership. (1) Rarity: any rarity tier that names this group in its Families.ForceGroups is FORCED onto every member, bypassing weight, difficulty band and spawn chance; the shipped Rarities/Boss.json does exactly that, which is what grants the boss tier here. Point a different tier's ForceGroups at this group to change that, or clear the boss tier's ForceGroups to stop forcing entirely. (2) Scope: members are classified SCOPE_BOSS, which caster-roster entries gate on via 'Scope': 'BOSS'. Entries are ROLE ASSET IDS (the Server/NPC/Roles/*.json filename), never in-game display names - an unresolvable non-wildcard entry is skipped with an engine warning. Wildcards use native IncludeRoles semantics, so '*Broodmother' catches a whole family. Owner/pack-editable: override this file to add or remove roles.
